summary: Wrote nothing; four blockers found. (1) The witness host lacks both generic mechanisms this cell's journeys require: a file-input load (setInputFiles) for the XLIFF FileReader surface, and download capture (acceptDownloads + download event) for the export surface. Neither exists anywhere in packages/, and the raw Playwright Page never escapes createPlaywrightWitnessHost. (2) The lanes do not share the font seam: critters inlined the stylesheet in the migrated lane, so baseline blocks fonts.googleapis.com while migrated blocks a fonts.gstatic.com woff2, giving two different mat-icon degradations. (3) u17 was not capability-only: 9 application files changed, including the FileReader service journey (a) drives. (4) Full vertical plus two novel host mechanisms exceeds this packet.
open_questions: Approve adding two generic mechanisms to packages/cli/src/witness/playwright-host.ts: a file-input load capability (Playwright setInputFiles, exposed through PageHandle or the host surface) and a download-capture capability (acceptDownloads: true on the context plus a capturedDownloads() readback of suggestedFilename/bytes/sha256). Both change context construction shared by all eleven existing verticals, so confirm whether the re-cut should land them as their own unit with a regression pass over existing witness runs before the tiny-translator journeys are written.

Rule on the per-lane mocked-seam divergence: baseline requests https://fonts.googleapis.com/icon?family=Material+Icons; migrated requests https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/materialicons/v145/flUhRq6tzZclQEJ-Vdg-IuiaDsNcIhQ8tQ.woff2 plus a preconnect to https://fonts.gstatic.com, because Angular 16 inlined the stylesheet at build time. Confirm both lanes declare their own query-free seam list, and confirm how the two different mat-icon degradations (baseline loses the font-family rule entirely, migrated keeps the inlined @font-face and loses only the woff2) should be asserted and probed without forcing false parity.

Confirm the accommodation inventory framing: the packet states the u17 series had capability-only edits, but u17d-final-green-lane.json records applicationFilesChanged with 9 application source files under 5 named capabilities, including src/app/model/asynchronous-file-reader.service.ts. Is the receipt's accommodation count 5 capabilities, 9 changed files, or a 19-step-equivalent mapping that must be derived? And should journey (a) treat the changed FileReader service as an open parity risk to be asserted explicitly rather than assumed behavior-preserving?

Confirm the canonical lane roots for the witness, since u17 emitted several: baseline .versionless/cache/angular-tiny-translator-v0-12-0-baseline/app/dist/rebuild-1 (524 files) versus dist/baseline or dist/rebuild-2, and migrated .versionless/stage/angular-tiny-translator-v0-12-0-u17b/dist-7 (524 files) versus dist-8.
